explication: Firebase Agent Skills is a collection of packaged instructions and scripts that help AI coding agents work with Firebase. The principal workflow is that an agent uses an installed skill for a Firebase task; the repository spans setup, Firebase services, security, and migration. README describes the collection and installation options, while individual skill contents were not sampled, so the graph shows the documented capability areas without inferring calls or internal handoffs.
